description: Underwater photo taken as part of the Biozaire 2 campaign: bathypter tripod fish, a species of abyssal fish with stilt fins, allowing it to stay above the mud. The Deep Environment/Gulf of Guinea (or BIOZAIRE) program was developed by Ifremer as part of the Gulf of Guinea study in collaboration with Total Exploration.
